name: bilingual-view
description: Translate Chinese prompts and typed question answers into English; display Chinese messages and question dialogs with shared host settings.

base_url.title: Translation Provider URL
base_url.description: OpenAI compatible Chat Completions base URL, including /v1 or another prefix, or the full /chat/completions endpoint. Messages that require input translation remain unsubmitted until configured.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: Model ID from this Provider. Translation does not change the model used by the Claude conversation.

effort.title: Translation reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the translation model. default omits reasoning_effort and uses the Provider's default; none disables reasoning where supported. Other levels require Provider and model support.

api_key.title: Translation Provider API key
api_key.description: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header only to the configured URL. Leave blank for a local service without authentication.

enabled.title: Translation enabled
enabled.description: When enabled, Chinese input is submitted in English and messages can display Chinese. When disabled, input and display remain unchanged.
